name: Camille Coduri
bio: ​From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Camille Coduri (born 8 October 1965 in Wandsworth, London) is an English actress. She is best known for her role in Doctor Who as Jackie Tyler appearing in a number of episodes between 2005 and 2010. She featured in the film comedies Nuns on the Run (1990) and King Ralph (1991). She has also appeared extensively on British television, appearing in guest roles in episodes of series such as Rumpole of the Bailey, A Bit of Fry and Laurie, Boon, A Touch of Frost and in the BBC's 1997 adaptation of Henry Fielding's novel The History of Tom Jones, a Foundling. She appeared in BBC Three's six-part drama series Sinchronicity in 2006. Camille participated in the Doctor Who-themed episode of The Weakest Link, first broadcast on 30 March 2007.
